manifest.name: code-review
manifest.description: Read-only code review pipeline: scout → review → synthesize.

nodes.task: Perform read-only reconnaissance of {{target}}: identify affected files and key symbols, including entry points, functions, and call chains. Return a compact file/symbol map.
Review {{target}} without modifying files. Focus on {{focus}}. Cite file:line evidence and severity for every finding. Check against these requirements: {{requirements}}.
Synthesize the review into a final report: one-paragraph summary, findings ordered by severity with file:line evidence, and open questions. Do not modify files.

intent: Inspect a code target without modifying it and return an evidence-backed review.

focus.default: correctness, regressions, unsafe behavior, missing tests

requirements.description: Requirements or acceptance criteria to review against.
